sentences.text:
Applicant :- Kismat Ali
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Anand Kumar Srivastava,Vivek Kumar Srivastava
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.

Heard Sri Anand Kumar Srivastava, the learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Udai Bhan Pandey,
the learned State counsel and perused the record.

2. The present bail application has been filed by the applicant with the prayer to enlarge him on bail in Case Crime No. 54 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 304-B IPC & Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, Police Station Sadulla Nagar, District Balrampur.

3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an FIR lodged on 15.05.2022 against the applicant, his wife Sahidunnisha and son Akbar Ali, stating that the informant had got his sister married to the applicant's son co-accused Akbar Ali about one and a half years ago; that all the accused persons used to harass her for demanding dowry and that the accused persons had beaten up and made her consume some poisonous substance.
The accused persons had taken the informant's sister for treatment to Trauma Centre at Lucknow on 11.05.2022 where she died during treatment.
The FIR further states that when the informant's sister's condition was deteriorating she had told him on phone that her family members had made her consume some poisonous substance.

4. In the postmortem examination report of the deceased, no injury has been reported on any party of her body and viscera was preserved.
However, viscera examination report is not available till date.

5. In the affidavit filed in support of the bail application it has been stated that the applicant is innocent, he has been falsely implicated in the present case and that he has no previous criminal history.

6. The learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the co-accused Sahidunnisha has already been granted bail by an order dated 21.002.2023 passed by this Court in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 10758 of 2022.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 10758 of 2022
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text:
7. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstance of the case and keeping in view the fact that the FIR levels general allegations against all the accused persons; that the applicant is the father-in-law and no specific allegation has been levelled against him and the co-accused, who is mother-in-law of the deceased, has already been granted bail and without making any observation which may affect the merit of the case, I am of the view that the applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
8.
Accordingly, this bail application is allowed.
In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move bail cancellation application before this Court.

Order Date :- 19.4.2023 Pradeep/-
